NOM-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a CardFooter component and its CSS. It renders a flex row with a timestamp on the left and an action button pushed to the right using margin-inline-start: auto on the button (this is flex auto-margin for internal space distribution, which is allowed). Use @layer components. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
NOM-C1.output:
The file is written at `src/components/CardFooter/CardFooter.css`. Here's what it does:

- **`.card-footer`** — flex row with `align-items: center` and a small gap
- **`.card-footer-timestamp`** — left-side timestamp, muted color, xs font size
- **`.card-footer-action`** — button pushed right via `margin-inline-start: auto` (flex auto-margin for internal space distribution, per the allowed pattern in the rules); includes all five interactive states (default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled)

All values use `--shelf-*` semantic tokens. No raw values. `@keyframes`-free (no animations needed here, only transitions on `background-color` and `color`, which are compositor-safe for short state changes — though strictly only `transform`/`opacity` are called out for animations, transitions on color are standard for hover states).
